provenance.film: Blade Runner 2049, memory-maker scene, clip memory.mp4; frames 147.375 s and 155.0 s kept in /home/claude/stelline-work/evolve-all-refs/ins/ (never in the repo)
provenance.method: candle base and shaft-top points read by hand from 4x crops; colours are 3x3 medians; cake-top ellipse as in refs/inscription.json

arcNote: angles in cake-top coords, 0 = right, -90 = back (away from the camera); the front sector is left free for the inscription

proportions.wickNote: dark gap between shaft top and flame on candles A and C, about 4-5 px of a 44 px shaft; rough
proportions.flickerNote: coefficient of variation of the bright flame-core height (luma > 185) over 64 registered frames 144.75-147.375 s, four flames: 0.093, 0.053, 0.099, 0.071 (includes registration jitter, so an upper bound)
proportions.note: 147.375 s: mean shaft length 44.3 px over a top diameter of 268 px, divided by cos(elevation 37 deg) for foreshortening; 155.0 s: shaft 43 px over cake width 217 px (camera about 7 deg above). Thickness and flame read on both frames. Stripe turns counted on candle B (about 8-9 visible bands)

colours.note: film medians under the warm grade (sRGB 0-255). red: the reddest decile of bright pixels on candles B and E (stripes are 1-2 px wide, so plain medians mix in the white); blue: the bluest decile of bright pixels on candle C; under the grade the blue stripe reads as a cool off-white

cakeTopDefault.note: used until the cake module exists: candles are built around the cake-top centre (y = 0 there), the top radius in metres as ui/standins.js
